status: Detailed concept cast selected by user; endpoint stills and motion prompts prepared for video generation.
duration_note: All durations below are proposed creative specifications, not measured clip lengths.

shared_constraints.camera: Fixed camera, framing, scale, lighting and background; no cuts, pans, zooms or shake.
shared_constraints.identity: Match the supplied cast reference and endpoint frames. Preserve silhouette, costume, anatomy, facial features and palette. Keep pixels visibly crisp and stable; no morphing or style drift.
shared_constraints.content: No text, letters, digits, equations, puzzle clues, praise, sparkles, extra characters or unplanned props. The hero’s Seal and the card offered by Lemma stay unmarked. Creature cards contain only their intended illustrations; Draw It adds one abstract brushstroke, never a diagram or mathematical symbol.
shared_constraints.audio: Silent video: no sound effects, music, speech or lip sync.
shared_constraints.endpoints: Use first.png and last.png as the exact opening and closing poses within each clip's own folder.
shared_constraints.integration: These are app-neutral production prompts, not runtime assets or authorization to change game behavior. Never derive a reaction from model wording or an unverified answer. Respect reduced-motion preferences if integrated later.

clips.motion_prompt: Animate Rivet from first.png through a quiet waiting loop. Rotate the brass monocle rim through one full turn around its fixed mount; Rivet blinks once while his body and tools stay still. Finish precisely at the opening pose, with the same open eyes and monocle orientation, matching last.png exactly. Make the loop seam invisible. Keep the camera fixed and pixels crisp. Preserve his design without morphing or new props. No text, digits, math, praise, sound, music or lip sync.

trigger_restrictions.allow: Only while a tutor request is actually pending. The loop indicates waiting, never evaluation.
trigger_restrictions.stop: Stop when the request resolves, fails, is cancelled, or the encounter is left; restore idle.
trigger_restrictions.forbid: Never trigger or change speed because an idea is judged right or wrong. Do not add an artificial delay to scripted replies.

clips.title: Rivet · thinking loop

clips.motion_prompt: Animate the apprentice from the relaxed idle pose in first.png to the hand-on-chin pose in last.png. trigger_restrictions.allow: When the child enters a thinking or dialogue workspace, independent of the content or correctness of their idea.
trigger_restrictions.stop: Hold the final thinking pose until the scene changes; do not repeatedly restart on every turn.
trigger_restrictions.forbid: Never use as hesitation, failure or correctness feedback; never play as a reward.
